how_to_extend: One entry per condition key {light}_{surface} (the middle of the frame name 4A8B_{light}_{surface}_{scene}_{nn}). place = the table AND the room: two conditions share a place when the same table in the same room is shot under another light; the same kind of table in another room is another place. light = the kind of light source on the table, one of window / overhead / lamp / mixed (mixed = two kinds at once, e.g. a lamp with some window light). Read by src/barrels/conditions.py. A condition missing here is guessed from its tags (place = its surface tag, light from the light tag's prefix) and flagged as guessed in every summary: add the entry the same day the condition is imported.
